title: audit.read
description: Returns the newest entries of the core's audit log, oldest first, and whether its hash chain in memory verifies. Each entry records one answered request: who called, the method, the target pane and the outcome, never pane contents or sent text. Needs hello version 2 and a caller in a terminal outside any pane: a caller in a pane or with no terminal is refused.

count.description: How many of the newest entries.

pane.description: Only calls made by or to this pane.

hash.description: SHA-256 of prev and the entry.

prev.description: The preceding entry's hash, or zeroes for the first.

caller.description: The calling pane, or null outside a pane or when unidentified.

terminal.description: Whether the caller had a controlling terminal; with a null caller, false means unidentified.

target.description: The pane the call named, if any.

scope.description: What the call needed: any caller, a terminal, the caller's own pane, another pane, or a terminal outside any pane.

reason.description: Short. For pane.send it ends with the text's size in bytes, never the text.

broken_at.description: The first sequence whose hash or link is wrong, or null.
